title: bug: PIV SELECT accepts wrong applet on malformed FCI
description: wp11_piv_select() validates the returned AID via tag 0x84 in the FCI block. If the FCI tag (0x6F/0x61) is present but malformed (truncated length, or no 0x84 tag), the scan loop exits via break without ever setting a found_aid flag, and the function returns WP11_PIV_OK. On multi-applet tokens, a SELECT that returns the wrong applet with garbled FCI silently passes validation. Subsequent APDUs then fail with confusing protocol errors. Fix: add a found_aid flag; if FCI was present but 0x84 was never found and matched, return WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING.
